repos_data.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides secure, read-only access to BigQuery datasets. Enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to safely query and analyze data through a standardized interface.
A Model Context Protocol server that provides read-only access to MySQL databases. This server enables LLMs to inspect database schemas and execute read-only queries.

A TypeScript implementation of a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that integrates with PiAPI's API. PiAPI makes user able to generate media content with Midjourney/Flux/Kling/LumaLabs/Udio/Chrip/Trellis directly from Claude or any other MCP-compatible apps.
A general-purpose MCP server that lets AI work with multiple databases within clear boundaries.

An MCP server (and a CLI) that lets an LLM query your databases in natural language through a business semantic layer — glossary, metric definitions, data dictionary, knowledge base, and example queries — grounded against your real schema.
Javascript Canvas Library, SVG-to-Canvas (& canvas-to-SVG) Parser
🤖 AI-first cross-database CLI tool. Query MySQL/PostgreSQL safely with read-only protection, SSH tunneling, and structured JSON output.
Persistent semantic memory for SQL databases (Postgres, MySQL, MSSQL, SQLite) — the MCP server with the most ironic name. One-line install for Claude Code, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible client.
MCP server that lets AI agents query SQL databases in natural language - read-only, with column masking, row caps, and query limits. SQLite / PostgreSQL / MySQL.
Fast SQL-only data application builder. Automatically build a UI on top of SQL queries.

repo_meta_data.description: One SQL interface for 60+ tools (e.g., GitHub, Notion, Airtable). Plug into any LLM through MCP.
